name: Tsukushite Ageru no ni!!
source:
Kadono Haruki, a skilled artist, is made to enter contests at a young age. Pressured because of his talent, he is troubled about what to draw. One day he takes a walk outside at night with his painting tools and enters a forest. There he finds a beautiful young girl. It's so unexpected that he thinks she's a fairy, is immediately captivated and asks whether he can draw her. After showing her the picture, the girl says that when they get older, she will make him his bridegroom. Being a child, he agrees.

Flashforward to the present. After entering high school Haruki has never met the girl. And all his paintings since then have all fallen short of that masterpiece. One day, a girl shows up at school and immediately kisses him, asking him to make good on his promise. Unfortunately, it happens in front of all his female childhood friends. Rushed by the sudden bold action of this newcomer, the childhood friends take action in order not to lose Haruki. Things will change from this point on...
translation:
才华出众的画家门野晴树自幼便被要求参加各种比赛。天赋带来的压力令他苦恼，不知道自己究竟该画什么。一天夜里，他带着画具出门散步，走进一片森林，并在那里发现一名美丽的小女孩。突如其来的相遇令他以为对方是妖精，立刻被她吸引，请求为她画像。女孩看过画后说，等两人长大，她会让晴树成为自己的新郎。年幼的晴树答应了。

时间来到现在。升入高中后，晴树始终没有再见到那名女孩，此后所有作品也都无法超越当年的杰作。一天，一名少女出现在学校，一见面便吻了他，要求他履行约定。不巧的是，这一幕被晴树所有女性青梅竹马亲眼看见。面对新来者突如其来的大胆行动，青梅竹马们为了不失去晴树也纷纷采取行动。从这一刻起，一切都将改变……
